title: World lighting settings
brief: Right-hand scene settings panel for /world, styled like the compact time console. Night-only lights driven by simulated time (on 18:00 through 05:59, off 06:00 through 17:59): TV backlight, setup backlight, left and right desk lamps, each with enable switch, color and intensity. Lower-left day controller kept. Panel is built to gain more settings as sections. Scene is a schematic SVG, not the live render.

artboards.title: Compact accordion
artboards.tradeoff: Closest match to the time console: same chassis, one-line summary and collapsible sections, smallest footprint; only one light is visible at a time, so comparing colors across lights takes extra clicks.

artboards.title: Rail and detail
artboards.tradeoff: Section rail scales best as settings grow and the editor gives one light full attention with a large preview; it is the widest panel (432 px) and adds one navigation level before you reach a control.

artboards.title: Grouped cards
artboards.tradeoff: Every light is editable at once, grouped by where it sits in the room (TV wall, desk setup), so matching colors is instant; the stack is the tallest and scrolls once more settings arrive, and it drifts furthest from the compact console look.
